SELECT fs.code as businessCode, fsr.sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN fsr.receive_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date - INTERVAL '1 month') AND DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date) > fsr.receive_date THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fsr.receive_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{params.month}::date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fsr.receive_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM #{params.month}::date) THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', fsr.receive_date) AND fsr.receive_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asCurrentMonthReceiveQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', #{params.month}::date - INTERVAL '1 month') >= DATE_TRUNC('month', fsr.receive_date) AND fsr.receive_date >= '2024-01-01' THEN fsr.receive_qty ELSE 0 END) AS asLastMonthReceiveQty FROM fba_shipment fs left join fba_shipment_detail fsd on fsd.main_id = fs.id and fsd.is_deleted = FALSE left join fba_shipment_receive fsr on fsd.id = fsr.detail_id and fsr.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fs.is_deleted = FALSE
and fs.code in
#{item}
GROUP BY businessCode,fsr.sku_id
